tools.name: get_practice_overview
tools.description: Overview of this website: who provides the service, what the service is, its limits, language, and canonical links (booking, terms, ethics, privacy). Call this first to ground any answer about the practice.

tools.name: get_services_and_pricing
tools.description: Session format, duration, price, and the payment / reschedule / no-show rules, verbatim from the site. Prices are in euros (EUR); sessions are conducted in Russian.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Frequently asked questions with the practitioner's own answers, verbatim (Russian): fit, session rhythm, booking, cancellations, payment, confidentiality, emergencies.

tools.name: get_inquiry_topics
tools.description: The list of concerns people bring to these consultations, verbatim from the site (Russian). Use it to judge whether a request matches this practice.

tools.name: get_contact_options
tools.description: Ways to reach Aleksandra: email, Telegram, and the booking page. Booking happens only via the official calendar on the site.

tools.name: get_available_slots
tools.description: Real free consultation slots for the next days, taken from the live schedule shown on the booking page. If no data is available, returns available=false with booking links — send the person to the booking page in that case.

tools.name: get_consultation_details
tools.description: Published session details by section. Unknown age, couple format, payment methods and approach are not inferred. No clinical suitability assessment.

tools.name: prepare_booking_handoff
tools.description: Prepare price, language, cancellation rules and a link to the official calendar. Optional selected start is checked against the live schedule. Does not reserve a slot or send a message.

tools.name: search_resources
tools.description: Search already published FAQ answers by short topic in Russian or English (locale defaults to ru). Returns exact text and canonical sources; do not send personal history.

tools.name: get_preparation_checklist
tools.description: Published questions, topics and practical rules before a session. Any personal notes stay on the person's device; this tool does not read or submit them.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_contact_options · Private data: get_contact_options · Public sink: get_contact_options, get_available_slots, prepare_booking_handoff, search_resources, get_preparation_checklist · Destructive: get_services_and_pricing, get_consultation_details.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_contact_options · Private data: get_contact_options · Public sink: get_contact_options, get_available_slots, prepare_booking_handoff, search_resources, get_preparation_checklist · Destructive: get_services_and_pricing, get_consultation_details

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
